PHASE 2 - NOT IMPORTED. Province-based or warehouse-specific deals whose province-wide validity could not be confirmed (seen in only some tracked warehouse areas of the province, single-city sighting with no regional flyer or official coupon confirming it, or a markdown). Each row says why. Review, then import as claimable (not expired) or price-point-only.
